notes.title: 📢 “Loser Got Isekai’d” Dev Update + Help Wanted 🙏
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/fa6f2f331919d3a425e1e71276d2ccd72735a771.gif"]



We’re a tiny indie team from Taiwan (fewer than 10 people), and this is our first R18 game: 

“Loser Got Isekai’d – Gotta Conquer the Girls Before Conquering the World.” 

It’s all about seducing heroines, mana transfer, and world domination! The demo is now available on Steam!  



It’s our very first time making a NSFW game, and also our debut on Steam. After consulting many experienced devs, we’ve learned that hitting 8,000 wishlists is the sweet spot for better visibility and traction at launch.  



Right now, we’ve just reached around 5,000 wishlists, and we still have a ways to go. 

So we’re here to shamelessly ask for your help 🙇‍♀️:  

👉 Love lewd and fun games? 

👉 Got friends who are also horny heroes? 

Please share our game, wishlist it, give it a like—it all helps bring us closer to launch!  



🧪 Once we hit the number, we’re launching right away. 

🧪 We also have more naughty projects in the works, so if you like our vibe, please stick around!  



Thanks again for all your support—and thank you for using your lovely little hands to click that wishlist ❤️
